name: liquid-shatter
title: Liquid Shatter
description: Lacquered WebGL ribbon rings that swell under the pointer, carry running light streaks, and shatter into stirrable glowing shards on press and hold.

props.name: ribbonCount
props.label: Ribbon Count
props.description: Number of nested ribbon rings, from 3 to 9.

props.name: scale
props.description: Multiplier on the size of the ribbons.

props.name: ribbonColor
props.label: Ribbon Color
props.description: Base colour of the lacquered ribbons.

props.name: glowColor
props.label: Glow Color
props.description: Colour of the hover glow, light streaks, shards and rim light.

props.name: backgroundColor
props.label: Background Color
props.description: Background behind the canvas.

props.name: metalness
props.description: How metallic the ribbon surface is, from 0 to 1.

props.name: roughness
props.description: How rough the ribbon surface is, from 0 to 1.

props.name: idleMotion
props.label: Idle Motion
props.description: Strength of the slow idle undulation.

props.name: streakFrequency
props.label: Streak Frequency
props.description: How often a light runs along a ribbon. 0 turns idle and scroll streaks off.

props.name: hoverStrength
props.label: Hover Strength
props.description: Strength of the liquid swell that trails the pointer.

props.name: tiltStrength
props.label: Tilt Strength
props.description: How far the ribbons tilt toward the pointer.

props.name: introAnimation
props.description: Rings ripple out from the centre on mount. Use Replay to see it again.
props.label: Intro Animation

props.name: sound
props.label: Sound
props.description: Plays sounds on tap, hold, shatter and reform. Audio starts on the first press, as browsers require.

props.name: holdToShatter
props.label: Hold to Shatter
props.description: Press and hold to shatter the ribbons into stirrable shards (mouse and trackpad only).

props.name: holdDuration
props.label: Hold Duration
props.description: Seconds of holding needed to charge a shatter.

props.name: reformDelay
props.label: Reform Delay
props.description: Seconds the shards float, stirrable, before they reform into ribbons.

props.name: particleCount
props.label: Particle Count
props.description: Number of shards the ribbons break into (about half on phones and low-power devices).

props.name: holdHint
props.label: Hold Hint
props.description: Shows a small "Press and hold" label with a charge bar at the bottom. Mouse and trackpad only.

props.name: onShatter
props.description: Called when a full hold shatters the ribbons.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root element. It fills the viewport height by default.

props.name: children
props.description: Content layered over the canvas. The layer ignores the pointer, so give interactive children pointer-events-auto.
